name: script-v4
idea_origin: script-v1/v3 have the higher ceiling (76.87, L6) but trust labels blindly; t13-read-v4 (DeepSeek decides) is steadier (71.67, 70.22). Keep DeepSeek's holistic pick and let the script only veto picks that its own codes flag, plus decide quarters.
hypothesis: A veto keeps v4's judgement while removing the risky 'pragmatic' picks (v2), the review-month losses and the hidden-wallet ruin, and the script's quarters keep the late-career upside.
predicted_behaviour: Games complete; L5-L6; vetoes are rare (a few per game) and mostly R+ picks.
refutation: Scores at or below t13-read-v4, or vetoes that DeepSeek fights or ignores.
